snippet.title: CRACK - Launch Trailer I What’s inside the egg?
snippet.description:
What’s in this GIANT egg? 

Play CRACK now on Steam to uncover the truth. 
Link here: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4312190/CRACK/

CRACK is a 1-4-player co-op adventure about cracking open a giant egg, understanding who brought you here, and why. 

The game is available today on Steam, Mac, Linux and Steam OS (Steam Deck). 

#steamgame #newgame #indiegame #coopgaming #trailer
